ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) distribution; high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels comprise approximately 5-8% of the visible ventral surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous low-intensity region covering the medial and proximal fluke. High-intensity mottled clusters are localized exclusively at the distal margins and tips of both the left and right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Narrow, sharp V-shaped depression with a deep vertical penetration into the fluke body, dividing the lobes symmetrically.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the trailing edge; serration amplitude increases at the distal tips compared to the medial sections.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve profile observed along the trailing edges extending from the central notch towards the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-contrast, roughly circular white pixel groups located on the extreme lateral tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, light-colored linear pixel disruptions (rake-like marks) visible on the lower-left quadrant of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized white scarring and structural irregularities at the extreme distal tips consistent with barnacle attachment sites.
